hazards.location_in_image: Center and left-center of the image

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Metal rails in the roadway can be a tripping or slipping hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk
hazards.description: The walking path is extremely narrow and further constrained by building steps, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass each other or use mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the front of the row houses

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures the visibility of pedestrians, particularly children, who may attempt to cross mid-block.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and contains debris, creating trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground along the left and right sides of the street.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street in the foreground.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street create significant visual obstructions, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians and vice versa.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage on this long residential block may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the visible street segment

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street light poles or luminaires are visible in this segment, which may reduce pedestrian safety and security after dark.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire streetscape

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the block

hazards.name: Lack of Dedicated Walkway
hazards.description: No visible sidewalk forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway, increasing the risk of conflict with vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Visible street area between buildings and parked cars

hazards.name: Embedded trolley tracks
hazards.description: The metal tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing mid-block and a slip hazard for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running longitudinally

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: Vehicles are parked partially on the sidewalk, severely restricting the effective width of the walkway and potentially forcing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left and right sides of the street where cars are parked.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans and other debris are placed directly in the narrow pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, in front of the red and white row houses.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Clutter
hazards.description: Debris and trash bags are present on the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles create a continuous visual barrier between the sidewalk and the travel lane, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians who might enter the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalk Clearance
hazards.description: Building stoops and railings reduce the effective width of the sidewalk, which may hinder pedestrians with strollers or mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side sidewalk

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obstruct the view between drivers and pedestrians, especially children, who might step into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom right corner where a car is parked.

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven surfaces around the trolley tracks create tripping hazards and potential vehicle instability.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway along the tracks

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Significant amount of trash and litter on the walkway creates tripping hazards and may force pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk in front of the row houses

hazards.name: Embedded Rail Tracks
hazards.description: Metal rails embedded in the street surface can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections or mid-block crossing points to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Adding street trees or planters would create a protective buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the streetscape.

interventions.title: Parking Management and Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensuring vehicles do not encroach on the sidewalk area preserves the full walking width for pedestrians and improves accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Widen and repair sidewalks to provide a clear, unobstructed, and ADA-compliant path of travel.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical buffer between the walkway and the street while improving the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near intersections to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand warrants, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage to provide a designated safe place to cross.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and personal security along the block.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install vertical traffic calming to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this narrow residential street.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implementing traffic calming measures would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a dense residential environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to eliminate cracks and implement regular cleaning to remove debris.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the ends of the block to improve visibility and reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved sidewalk to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Implement strict enforcement of sidewalk parking bans and install bollards or higher curbs to prevent vehicle encroachment on the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for residents walking at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the roadway surface, particularly around the embedded tracks, to eliminate tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Management
interventions.description: Implement clear-path policies to ensure trash receptacles and signage do not block the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Regular Sanitation and Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement frequent street and sidewalk cleaning to remove debris and maintain a clear walking path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone with trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.
